_meta.description: Captain backgrounds. The player IS the captain. They chose what to study, and that background gives them a discounted version of a crew specialist's skills. A captain-botanist is NOT as good as a crew botanist — skill_modifier 0.5 means half the effort contribution, half the passive bonus, and narrative unlocks are fewer or less effective. This makes crew selection meaningful: you complement your weaknesses, not double down on strengths. Or you double down. That's also a valid, terrible choice.
_meta.skill_modifier: 0.5 = captain gets half the effort_contribution value, half the passive effect, and reduced active skill uses (where applicable). This is the 'studied it in school but didn't make it a career' discount.
_meta.crew_cap: Captain + 0, 1, or 2 crew. Ship supports max 3 humans. 0 crew is possible with a warning. Stowaway events can push past this if someone is jettisoned.

captains.title: Studied Botany
captains.flavor: You know plants. Not as well as Dr. Osei, but well enough to tell when something is wrong. Usually.

passive_effect.description: Crop health events slightly improved. Crop water consumption reduced 7% (vs. crew botanist's 15%).

narrative_unlocks: Basic plant identification — less detail than crew botanist
Can stabilize sick crop in emergencies (less effective than Greenhouse Protocol)

starting_bonus.description: Crop starts at 85 instead of 80 — you prepped the growbay properly

captains.selection_flavor: You studied botany. Your parents asked what you'd do with that degree. This. This is what.

captains.title: Studied Engineering
captains.flavor: You can fix things. Not as fast as Kazuki, and you eat a normal amount.

passive_effect.description: Hull repair events slightly improved. Fabricator wear reduced 10% (vs. crew engineer's 20%).

narrative_unlocks: Basic mechanical repair options
Can attempt improvised fabricator repair (lower success chance than crew engineer)

starting_bonus.description: Hull starts at 105 instead of 100 — you reinforced the weak points before launch

captains.selection_flavor: You studied engineering. The ship makes sounds it shouldn't. You recognize most of them.

captains.title: Studied Medicine
captains.flavor: You passed the exam. You are not a doctor. Do not call yourself a doctor. Dr. Vasquez will know.

passive_effect.description: Injury outcomes slightly improved. 15% chance lethal downgrades to injury (vs. medic's 30%).

narrative_unlocks: Basic first aid options — not full treatment
Can identify symptoms (but not always correctly)

starting_bonus.description: Start with a basic medical kit — one free injury heal

captains.selection_flavor: You studied medicine. Halfway. The residency was... there were circumstances. You're fine.

captains.title: Studied Piloting
captains.flavor: You can fly the ship. This is expected of a captain. You are slightly better at it than expected.

passive_effect.description: Fuel efficiency improved 5% (vs. crew pilot's 10%). Calibration microgame slightly easier.

narrative_unlocks: Basic evasion options in combat
Can read navigation charts without crew pilot (but less accurately)

starting_bonus.description: Fuel starts at 105 — you calculated the most efficient departure window

captains.selection_flavor: You studied piloting. You are statistically correct 68% of the time. Reeves would say that's amateur.

captains.title: Studied Culinary Arts
captains.flavor: You can cook. Not like Reyes, but you can make algae rations taste like something other than regret.

passive_effect.description: Food consumption reduced 7% (vs. crew chef's 15%). Morale +0.5 from meals.

narrative_unlocks: Basic edibility judgment — less reliable than crew chef
Can prepare a decent meal in crisis (smaller morale boost)

starting_bonus.description: Food starts at 105 — you packed well

captains.selection_flavor: You studied culinary arts. In space, this means you know 47 ways to prepare algae. Forty-six of them are bad.

captains.title: Studied Xenobiology
captains.flavor: You studied aliens. You have never met one. This could go either way.

passive_effect.description: Anomaly events slightly safer. Basic biological analysis available.

narrative_unlocks: Basic alien encounter options (less effective than crew xenobiologist)
Can identify some biological specimens (with less certainty)

starting_bonus.description: Start with a spectrometer — it was part of your thesis

captains.selection_flavor: You studied xenobiology. Your thesis was theoretical. Everything is about to become very applied.

captains.title: Studied Diplomacy
captains.flavor: You studied diplomacy. This means you are very good at making people feel heard while doing nothing.

passive_effect.description: Station interactions slightly improved. Negotiation events slightly better.

narrative_unlocks: Basic negotiation options (less effective than crew diplomat)
Station merchants are slightly friendlier

starting_bonus.description: You start with extra credits — you know people

captains.selection_flavor: You studied diplomacy. Your crew does not find this reassuring.

captains.title: Business Background
captains.flavor: You ran a business. Whether it was successful is a matter of perspective. You have inventory management instincts.

passive_effect.description: Station prices reduced 10%. Barter options occasionally available in events.

narrative_unlocks: Barter options in some events
Can appraise loot-only items for trade value

starting_bonus.description: You start with significantly more credits — you liquidated assets

captains.selection_flavor: You ran a business. You are going to run this mission like a business. The crew has feelings about this.

captains.title: Academic Background
captains.flavor: You have a PhD. In what is not immediately relevant. You argue with ship AIs.

passive_effect.description: Scientific instrument events have additional options. Research reveals hidden event info.

narrative_unlocks: Research options that reveal hidden event outcomes before choosing
Argues with the ship AI constantly — sometimes productively
Scientific instrument events have one extra option

starting_bonus.description: Start with a gas analyzer — grant funding covered it

captains.selection_flavor: You have a PhD. Your grant funding was cut. You are in space. These events are related.

captains.title: Military Background
captains.flavor: You served. Where is classified. What you did is classified. Your therapist is classified.

passive_effect.description: Combat minigames start with a screen-clear. Morale drops from combat events reduced.

narrative_unlocks: Tactical assessment — reveals enemy pattern in combat minigame
Refers to every new planet as 'basically Kandahar'
Combat event options with slightly better odds

starting_bonus.description: Start with a pressure suit — you kept yours

captains.selection_flavor: You served. You don't talk about it. Your crew will ask exactly once.
